review_reference: The services as deployed now. Backend release backend-41837350227-1-5b83bd31f00f8c03 (D-Eminence/hid-system#164 at f95ce97) rebuilt and redeployed all twelve services and the database migration: migrations 0104 (records-processing cover) and 0105 (document virus scanner fields; scan routes internal-only), and new Health IDs that mix letters and digits. Then backend release backend-41856305880-1-9171f44467b57341 (D-Eminence/hid-system#167 at f11c9ec) redeployed ehr-api and lab-api: the patient chat cites only its own sources and adds the server's "Talk to your doctor" lines, the chat source viewer answers 404 CHAT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE for a source it may not show, and the staff chat covers one patient per chat. So ehr-api and lab-api are pinned to f11c9ec and every other service to f95ce97. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins (34d6955): the document fields scanStatus and detected type, the new Health ID format, and the patient chat changes above; nothing else this frontend calls changed shape. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-11-04: "approve re-pin" (Q29), in reply to the plan to point the website at the backend as deployed after the patient chat safety release, which also releases website batch 4.
